position_sizing: Source strategy() declaration determines defaults when present; no exchange risk budget is inferred. See source for qty/default_qty_type/default_qty_value.
filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
implementation_notes: Paraphrased from the cited Pine source file. Pivot/fractal conditions can be confirmed only after right-side bars; confirm signal timestamp and avoid hindsight fills. Higher-timeframe/security or repaint behavior requires independent causal review. Grid/DCA order stacking, capital cap, and liquidation mechanics may not match the backtest emulator.
